title: Open the work from the card

decision.q: Card links into the running project

options.label: Yes
options.act: Card 'open' targets: url/path, logs, file:line, media
options.then: Let a card open what it's about: a URL, logs, a file at a line, or a film.

why: A card can open what it's about, in the thing that runs it: the dev server at the right page, a command's logs, a file at a line, a film, a screenshot. Switchboard already knows each server's port and URL. That's Vercel comments' "review on the running thing", and the Flex design's "Open in Flex".
